title: 23 Serious Runway Near-Misses Came From Mistakes And Hotspots
hook: Runway danger clusters around simple ground mistakes and a few airports.
closing: Preventing the next collision means fixing both ground coordination and the airports where danger concentrates.
question: Which airport risk worries you most?

segments.say: Safety officials logged 23 serious runway near-misses, more than double the pace about a decade earlier.
People or vehicles entering by mistake caused 60 percent of incursions, making ground coordination the main vulnerability.
Just 8 airports held almost a third of the worst near-misses, concentrating that vulnerability geographically.
